name: Eastvale Logging Camp
summary: At Eastvale Logging Camp, timber orders from Stormwind meet the dangers of Elwynn’s eastern woods. Wolves and bears drive lumberjacks from their work, while the camp keeps timber moving toward Stormwind and nearby settlements.

sections.title: A Vital Operation Under Siege
sections.body: Timber buyers across the Kingdom of Stormwind send orders to Eastvale Logging Camp, each with a strict deadline. Wolves and bears prowl the woods around the work sites, driving lumberjacks away and leaving cut timber behind. Supervisor Raelen directs the camp’s work, and travelers help drive off the beasts and recover the abandoned wood before deliveries fall behind schedule.

sections.title: Life on the Eastern Frontier
sections.body: Eastvale Logging Camp has homes and horse stables where travelers can buy fine mounts. On a nearby hill above the work site, retired Marshal Haggard lives in a quiet manor. He once led the Stormwind Guard and left its service to retire far from the politics of the capital.

faq.q: What is the main purpose of Eastvale Logging Camp?
faq.answer: Eastvale Logging Camp is the primary timber source in eastern Elwynn Forest for the Kingdom of Stormwind. Its lumberjacks work long hours to meet strict deadlines and supply builders and nobles across the realm.

faq.q: Why is the logging camp always hiring adventurers?
faq.answer: Wolves and bears menace the workers in the dense woods around Eastvale Logging Camp. Their attacks drive lumberjacks away from cut timber and put orders at risk of missing shipment deadlines.
Marshal Haggard is the retired former leader of the Stormwind Guard. He stepped down from service a few years ago and now lives in a peaceful estate on the bluffs above Eastvale Logging Camp.

faq.q: Can you buy mounts at Eastvale Logging Camp?
faq.answer: Yes. Eastvale Logging Camp’s horse stable sells riding horses and offers riding training.

angles.text: As a human of Stormwind, you rely on Eastvale’s timber to rebuild and maintain the kingdom’s settlements.
At Eastvale Logging Camp, you can buy dependable Stormwind steeds.
